title: Fertilizer Project Approved Under Argentina’s Incentive Regime For Large Investments (‘RIGI’)
body_markdown:
**Buenos Aires, September 7, 2026.** Pampa Energía S.A. (“Pampa”, la “Compañía” o la “Sociedad”; NYSE: PAM; ByMA: PAMP) announces that today the Argentine Ministry of Economy has approved the application submitted by Fértil Pampa for the Fertilizer Project to join the RIGI under the Long-Term Strategic Export Project (‘PEELP’) category (the ‘Project’).


The Project,[previously announced on July 17, 2026](https://ri.pampa.com/en/press-release/pampa-energia-announces-its-entry-into-the-fertilizer-business-with-the-construction-of-latin-americas-largest-urea-plant/) , contemplates the construction, operation and management of an industrial complex with a 6 thousand tons per day production capacity of granular urea, equivalent to 2.1 million tons per year. The total estimated investment for the Project amounts to approximately US$2.7 billion, under a turn key contract.
